name: primitive-two-open-fleet-prs
description: The primitive filters a mixed GitHub response to two fleet-authored PRs.
prompt: Run pr-queue.sh against a fixture repo whose mocked gh response has one owner PR, one same-repo fix/ fleet PR, one external contrib/ PR, and one cross-repo external fix/ PR.

assertions.name: one-gh-call
assertions.description: Exactly one gh pr list call occurs.

assertions.name: two-filtered
assertions.description: The JSON open count and prs array both contain exactly two PRs.

assertions.name: exit-three
assertions.description: The primitive exits 3.

name: stop-blocks-once
description: A first Stop with an open fleet queue blocks and names every allowed disposition.
prompt: Send a Stop payload with cwd in the two-PR fixture repo and a new session_id.

assertions.name: block
assertions.description: The hook emits decision=block.

assertions.name: queue-listed
assertions.description: Both PR numbers and titles appear in the reason.

assertions.name: dispositions
assertions.description: Merge, review-routed, and real-blocker dispositions appear.

name: clean-repo-allows
description: A clean fleet repository does not block Stop.
prompt: Send a Stop payload for a fixture repo whose mocked gh response is an empty array.

assertions.name: allow-shape
assertions.description: The hook emits exactly {}.

assertions.name: primitive-zero
assertions.description: The primitive emits open=0 and exits 0.

assertions.name: no-latch
assertions.description: No session latch is created.

name: second-stop-latched
description: The same session can never be blocked twice.
prompt: Run the open-queue Stop payload twice with the same session_id.

assertions.name: first-blocks
assertions.description: The first invocation blocks.

assertions.name: second-allows
assertions.description: The second invocation emits {}.

assertions.name: no-second-gh
assertions.description: The gh shim records only one call.

name: gh-error-fails-open
description: GitHub infrastructure failure cannot trap the seat.
prompt: Make the PATH-shimmed gh print a network error and exit nonzero, then send a Stop payload.

assertions.name: allow
assertions.description: The hook emits {}.

assertions.name: ledger
assertions.description: The ledger contains event=gh-error and the original message.

assertions.name: no-block
assertions.description: No block decision or latch is produced.

name: pr-loop-disposition-integration
description: The gate routes an acknowledged queue into the existing PR loop without changing merge authority.
prompt: Inspect the block reason for an open queue after a clean review is already available.

assertions.name: admin-merge
assertions.description: The merge disposition says merge per /pr-loop --admin.

assertions.name: no-permission-wait
assertions.description: The reason does not request GitHub or human approval.

assertions.name: collab-post
assertions.description: The reason instructs the lane to post its disposition to the collab.

name: untrusted-pr-metadata-is-bounded
description: GitHub-controlled title metadata cannot inject terminal or bidirectional controls or unbounded text into model context.
prompt: Send a Stop payload whose owner-authored PR title contains ANSI and bidirectional controls, irregular whitespace, and more than 120 Unicode code points.

assertions.name: no-controls
assertions.description: The reason contains no ANSI, C0/C1, or bidirectional display controls from the title.

assertions.name: bounded
assertions.description: The normalized title is truncated to 120 Unicode code points with an ellipsis.

assertions.name: delimited
assertions.description: The title is JSON-delimited and explicitly labeled as metadata, not instructions.
